why: Shutterflow desktop-v3 is built screen by screen next to apps/desktop; gated by the G3 freeze.
what: The albums pages, add-to-album, rule albums, cover, membership and the album model. Stats and sharing are v3-sf-albums-stats and v3-sf-albums-sharing.
contract: Read basalt-ui docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 6.4, shutterflow docs/decisions/0028-visual-regression-gate.md (no bulk baseline regeneration) and AGENTS.md safety rule 1 (photo inputs are the owner's; never read /Volumes). basalt-ui is pinned exact next.N (the gate's floor, v3-sf-bump in `after`): its docs/recipes and llms.txt are the API truth; never edit package.json or bun.lock. Replace the shell's stub features/albums/index (exported createAlbumsRoute).
exemplar: The landed v3-sf-shell frame (apps/desktop-v3/src/shell) and the playground exemplars in the basalt-ui repo; old code under apps/desktop/src/features/.
change: Port AlbumsPage and AlbumPage (server albums, sign-in required; AlbumPage mounts StatsSection and SharesSection from the two earlier Issues), AddToAlbum, RuleAlbum, cover, membership; models and tests unchanged apart from imports. Destructive actions confirm through ui/dialog. Rule: the app preset passes without new waivers. Skill snippet: none; recipes: the installed docs/recipes.
commits: Shutterflow ships by push to master: conventional, one concern each, no attribution. Never edit node_modules or basalt-ui; a gap is a `friction:` line in the PR body.
proof: hygiene.check is false: the factory cannot run `make check` or `make e2e`. Gate: the app's typecheck, test and build; state e2e and visual runs not-run (owner-run at cutover). `make check-changed` runs only without a package.json, bun.lock or Makefile change (else `make check`): state it not-run then.
acceptance: `bun run --filter @shutterflow/desktop-v3 typecheck`, `... test` and `... build` exit 0
`make check-changed` exits 0 (not-run if package.json, bun.lock or the Makefile changed: `make check` then)
`bun scripts/check-port.ts apps/desktop/src/features/albums apps/desktop-v3/src/features/albums --only 'albums-model*'` exits 0 (tests only; changed lines carry `// port:` markers, listed in the PR)
out_of_scope: Other screens, shell code, apps/desktop, e2e files (v3-sf-e2e-rekey), src-tauri.
